name: founder
description: Founder workbench for AI-assisted new-business planning across Claude Code & Codex CLI — business-item discovery, ideation, concretization, and planning composition through the six cognitive verbs (ADR-0036). The second L3 persona after engineer: workflow machinery, hooks, all six verb surfaces (investigate / frame / decide / compose / critique / refine), the business ensemble protocol, the founder:start lifecycle macro, and the resume / checkpoint / peer-now meta skills — all shipped (ADR-0036 Accepted).

interface.shortDescription: AI-assisted new-business planning — discovery, ideation, decision, planning, review/refine, plus the founder:start lifecycle macro and resume/checkpoint/peer-now meta skills (the second L3 persona; ADR-0036 Accepted)
interface.longDescription: L3 persona plugin for new-business planning, the second L3 persona after engineer (ADR-0036). Exposes the six universal cognitive verbs as canonical skills with business-anchored content; this release ships all six — investigate (business-item discovery via the business-brief profile: a 5-tier business source taxonomy, freshness/jurisdiction tagging, paywalled-source rules, and a privacy gate before web search and peer dispatch), frame (ideation: turning evidence into a structured business opportunity model), decide (business decision across the decisive market-attractiveness + unit-economics axes plus the regulatory-exposure + safety-risk veto gates, carried on a persona-local decision registry per ADR-0036 SD3), compose (planning artifacts: a venture plan, a lean canvas, or a validation plan), critique (multi-perspective review of a business artifact, or an adversarial red-team pre-mortem of an entire venture), and refine (applying critique findings and verifying the revised artifact still reconciles). Each verb is invokable as $founder:<verb>, and the nine business-anchored ensemble point templates are formalized in founder's own ensemble protocol. Sub-discipline expansion (business-model archetypes — b2b-saas, consumer-app, commerce, content) flows through the L4 profile axis (MVP ships the general default). The $founder:start lifecycle macro sequences the six verbs end-to-end with direction + plan approval gates (terminal present+save; no auto-commit), and the workflow-continuity meta skills (resume / checkpoint / peer-now) each carry a Host-availability matrix (ADR-0022). ADR-0036 is Accepted — validated end-to-end by a real-topic dogfood; the first production venture dogfood runs in a separate per-venture content repo per SD5. Bidirectional companion ensembles (Claude <-> Codex) dispatch automatically at command-mode phase boundaries under an always-max policy. Codex skills provide cognitive-runbook parity, not host-bootstrap/state parity (ADR-0036 SD2 / ADR-0021 boundary).
defaultPrompt: $founder:investigate Is there a market for a back-office SaaS for independent restaurants?
$founder:investigate business-brief subscription pet-supply boxes in Korea
$founder:frame Shape this candidate item into an opportunity model before I decide
$founder:decide Compare these two business directions and recommend one (--size=major)
$founder:compose Draft the venture plan for the chosen direction
$founder:critique Review this venture plan before I commit (--profile=red-team for a pre-mortem)
$founder:refine Apply the critique findings to the plan and verify it still reconciles
$founder:start Take this business idea from discovery to a reviewed plan in one pass
